researcher_notes: Proposed = 2025. The GEM 'Kemaman LNG Terminal' is the E&H Energy RGT Kemaman (RM3.7bn independent multi-user LNG import/regasification terminal at Teluk Kalong, Kemaman, Terengganu). It was first publicly proposed/announced in February 2025 via an MoU exchange ceremony between E&H Energy Sdn Bhd and Menteri Besar Incorporated Terengganu. It is a brand-new project (Letter to Proceed targeted Q2 2026, supply from 2028, operations ~2029), so the first public proposal cannot predate 2025. Three independent publishers (dagangnews [ms], evolusibina [ms], thesun [en]) all verifier-PASS with '2025' + 'Kemaman' present.

Proposed = 2018. The debottlenecking of Trains 1-6 (+3.4 mtpa) is the brownfield component of the NLNG Train 7 / 'NLNGSevenPlus' expansion (22.5 -> 30 mtpa; +4.2 mtpa new Train 7 plus +3.4 mtpa debottlenecking of existing trains). The expansion including the debottlenecking scope was first publicly proposed/announced in 2018, when NLNG awarded the FEED contracts (July 2018) and sought ~$7bn for the expansion; FID followed on 27 Dec 2019. JPT (SPE) is the strong industry source naming both '2018' and 'debottlenecking'; two independent project-timeline articles corroborate the same year+scope (all three verifier-PASS). 2018 (FEED-stage public announcement) chosen as the earliest clear public proposal of the debottlenecking expansion; the Dec 2019 OGJ/Eni items are the FID/launch, which post-dates the proposal.

No externally-verifiable cancellation year exists. This is a GEM-inferred status ('cancelled, inferred 4 y'): no sponsor or regulator ever announced a cancellation. The project originated as EMA's Expression of Interest to Build-Own-Operate an Offshore LNG Terminal in Singapore, published Nov 2019 (EMA primary source: ema.gov.sg consultation 20191108), and simply lapsed with no advancement. Per GEM lifecycle rules an 'inferred 4 y' year = the year the 4-year-dormancy inference was made (i.e. Nov 2019 + 4y, ~2023; GEM flagged 'no updates in over four years' as of mid-2024) -- an internal GEM data-entry value, not an event reported by any independent publisher, so it cannot be corroborated by the URL verifier (no page ties this terminal to a cancellation YEAR). Documented anchor: EoI Nov 2019. Suggested fill if methodology is applied directly: 2023 (or the actual year-of-inference). Marked UNRESOLVED because the cancelled-milestone year is unsourceable by design.

No externally-verifiable shelving year exists. This is a GEM-inferred status ('shelved, inferred 2 y'): no sponsor announced a pause. The Sycar FLNG (at the Complejo Petroquimico Jose Antonio Anzoategui, near Barcelona, Anzoategui) was proposed Nov 2022 via a Sycar-PDVSA MoU (signed 10-11 Nov 2022; LNG Prime, Riviera, Petroleumag/GNLglobal [es]), targeting first LNG exports 'as early as 2024'. It went dormant after the US OFAC license route closed -- OFAC General License 44 expired 18 Apr 2024 and Venezuela oil/gas sanctions were restored -- which foreclosed the project's required US export licence. Per GEM lifecycle rules an 'inferred 2 y' year = the year the 2-year-dormancy inference was made (i.e. Nov 2022 + 2y, ~2024) -- an internal GEM value, not an event reported by any independent publisher, so it cannot be corroborated by the URL verifier (no page ties this terminal to a shelving YEAR). Documented anchor: proposal Nov 2022. Suggested fill if methodology is applied directly: 2024 (or the actual year-of-inference). Marked UNRESOLVED because the shelved-milestone year is unsourceable by design. Spanish-language searches (gnlglobal.com, petroleumag.com) found only the 2022 proposal, no shelving announcement.
